scope: Read-only post-fit tree-capacity audit; no labels scored and no fits run

sampled_match_support.selection: Evenly spaced among exact training-eligible stride2 rows per match/view; context built before selecting.
sampled_match_support.interpretation: Distinct match coverage among sampled rows. Missing sampled support does not prove no full-training support; match count does not count independent spells. Clean/dropout views remain the same match.
